stack.notes: narduk-platform is a contracts-only package (types/schemas), not a UI package. Product is a public Open Graph / social-card preview simulator (og:title/og:image preview across Discord/Facebook/IMessage/LinkedIn/Slack/Telegram/Twitter/WhatsApp) -- functionally adjacent to but distinct from narduk-seo's admin-facing OgImagePreviewLab (which previews YOUR OWN app's og:image routes in an admin panel; ogpreview-app previews ANY public URL's social-card rendering for end users).

local_reimplementations.name: what-is-open-graph.vue data table
local_reimplementations.notes: Lines 236-267: a genuine native <table> for a comparison table, with an explicit `eslint-disable narduk/no-native-table` comment (line 236). CROSS-CUTTING FINDING: this proves a narduk-libs eslint rule named narduk/no-native-table actively discourages bare <table> elements estate-wide, with an escape hatch for real tabular content -- this explains why no other component surveyed anywhere in this lane used a literal <table> without either avoiding it (div-grid/card patterns) or an explicit disable comment. Worth flagging to the L0/narduk-libs lane and the orchestrator: a new shared table component likely needs to be the sanctioned way to satisfy this rule, or itself be exempted.

top_extraction_candidates.name: AppConfirmModal adoption over window.confirm()
top_extraction_candidates.why: Native browser confirm() for a destructive action ('clear all history') is a worse anti-pattern than any hand-rolled modal seen elsewhere in this lane -- trivial, high-value fix once a shared confirm modal exists.

top_extraction_candidates.name: narduk/no-native-table eslint rule (cross-cutting finding)
top_extraction_candidates.why: Discovered via the one eslint-disable comment in this repo; likely explains why zero literal <table> elements were found anywhere else across this lane's 6 repos. Relevant to the shared table component's own design and to L0's narduk-libs eslint-config survey.

notes: Marketing/content-heavy public tool (OG/social-card preview simulator), legacy template layer consumer, no narduk-seo/narduk-core proper. Its 9 platform-preview components (819 LOC) are bespoke product surface, not extraction targets. The standout finding is NOT table-shaped: it's the narduk/no-native-table eslint rule surfaced by one eslint-disable comment, which is likely why this entire lane (6 repos) found almost no literal <table> usage -- apps are being steered toward div-grid/card patterns by lint, not by lack of a shared table component. Recommend the orchestrator confirm this rule's exact definition and scope via the L0 narduk-libs-internal lane.
